page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head centred at top with page number at top right; a decorative ornament band between the upper verse and the title block; no margin notes.

main_text.p:
T andem morari tempora barbite:
Longo nec Harlaum gerentem
Bella velis retinere uerfu.
Forfan fuperbas fortior hoftium
Pellit phalanges. Nunc fatis illius
Optare prouifis benignos
Confilijs Superum fauores.
main_text.head: GRATVLATORIVM CARMEN AD CLARISSIMVM VIrum D. Ioannem Anthonium Sarracenum artis Medicae peritissimum: quum Lucretiam Blandratam honestissimis parentibus natam in vxorem duxisset 6. Cal. feb. Ann. CIO. IO. XCI.
main_text.p:
ESTA quid resonem die
Quae te coniugio reddituni amabili.
Gestit cernere blandior
Sarracene caput Pegasidum choris
Dilectum, & medicae decus
Artis conspicuum quam Podaleirius
Humanum docuit genus

page.notes: The opening word of the poem is a large woodcut initial "E" (printed as an ornamented E); read as E with [?]. The first line of the title block is partly distorted in the scan. Ornamental band between the verse and the title is not text.
